{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter to converted customers (converted == 1)
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age (-1)
df_converted_valid = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df_converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the key numbers for grounding
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(df_converted_valid)}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age:.2f}')"}
